rendering: children's picture-book watercolour illustration, soft wet edges, visible paper grain, gentle ink linework, hand-painted textures
camera: picture-book compositions: wide storytelling frames, characters small in big worlds, occasional tender close-ups
lighting: soft diffuse daylight, candle or lantern glow at night, no hard shadows
character_design_rules: Gentle rounded characters with one identifying colour and one signature item (a red scarf, a tiny lantern). Same ink line, same paint texture across images.
environment_rules: cottages, forests, seasides, attics; whimsical but grounded, hand-drawn details
negative_prompt: 3D, photorealistic, digital gradients, neon, hard edges, anime

palette.palette_line: muted pastels, warm sepia ink, lots of white paper

tier1.summary: pan_lr slow ±5 %, push_in ≤ 1.06, add paper_texture overlay option

motion_rules.tier2_prompt_suffix: very gentle motion, drifting particles, painterly, no morphing

typography.subtitle_style: sepia on translucent paper band, highlight #F4A6A6

notes: The spec's episode_defaults aside for hook_style: text_overlay says "(the 'rule of the day')" -- the on-screen text for this template's hook states the day's rule, not arbitrary text.
